title: Student and Staff Computing Devices

delivery_date: Any awarded vendor will need to coordinate a schedule of deliveries with the Dallas ISD ED TECH department.

bid_summary:
bid_summary

The RFP is for Student and Staff Computing Devices for Dallas ISD. The purpose is to solicit proposals for providing laptops, Chromebooks, and tablets. Major products/services requested include student and staff computing devices, including Windows laptops (with autopilot) and Chromebooks (with Google Management enrollment). Important contract information includes a one-year warranty for student Chromebooks and three years for student and staff Windows laptops. Contract duration is one-year warranty for student Chromebooks and three years for student and staff Windows laptops. Additional break-fix repair programs can be included as additional pricing in the attachments section.
product_specification: Laptop Battery Life: This will be based on the manufacturer's specifications.
For Windows devices, autopilot is required.
For Chromebooks, enrollment in Google Management is required.
The quantities will be spread over life of the contract.
